title: Nscale Hires Meta's Justin Osofsky to Be COO Ahead of IPO
source_used: Yahoo Finance (Bloomberg wire text); Nscale press release on PR Newswire also read
key_facts: Nscale, an AI infrastructure company, hired long-time Meta executive Justin Osofsky as chief operating officer.
Osofsky worked at Meta for 18 years and was most recently its chief partnerships officer.
He reports to CEO Josh Payne and oversees global operations; Nscale's press release lists People, EMEA, APAC, Business Development, Communications, Marketing, Global Policy and M&A under him.
Nscale filed in September for an IPO in New York and is seeking to raise as much as $3 billion, per Bloomberg News.
The London-based company was spun off from a crypto mining operation in early 2024 and rents out computing power to AI developers; Nvidia and Microsoft are partners.
Former Meta COO Sheryl Sandberg sits on Nscale's board and helped recruit other Meta veterans such as Nick Clegg.
Nscale announced the appointment itself on 2 Oct 2026.
quote_evidence: Nscale, the artificial intelligence infrastructure company, hired a long-time Meta Platforms Inc. executive to be its chief operating officer, to accelerate a rapid expansion connected to its upcoming initial public offering, according to a person familiar with the matter.
Nscale is seeking to raise as much as $3 billion in the IPO, Bloomberg News has reported.
Nscale, the vertically integrated AI infrastructure company, today announced the appointment of Justin Osofsky as Chief Operating Officer (COO).
why_it_matters_hint: Nscale is building a senior team of Meta veterans as it prepares a New York share sale.
event_date: 2 Oct 2026 (Bloomberg report and Nscale press release)
